answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the prism is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Each submission hangs on the comet of a task receipt, and the meadow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
